summary: Ares Real Estate Income Trust filed a routine Form 8-K updating its September 30, 2026 net asset value per share and November 1, 2026 transaction price, which equals each class's NAV per share. The board, including a majority of independent directors, adopted valuation procedures; Altus Group U.S. Inc. serves as independent valuation advisor, providing appraisals and reviewing DST Program loan valuations. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic event is disclosed. Watch for monthly NAV/transaction-price updates and any shift in the share-redemption or distribution posture, but no risk-arb angle applies.
